notes.title: Slot Shots Pinball Collection Version 4.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
Today was a major update for the title, here is a rundown of some of the changes-

* A brand new DMD was installed for six of the tables, however we intentionally left the original DMD for Outergalactic Aliens

* Fixed an issue when viewing the leaderboard and starting a new game that would occasionally cause the leaderboard to pop up on the pause menu

* Fixed an issue when restarting or playing a second game on the same table would occasionally cause the nudge feature to stop working

* Added a warning on the main menu and table select regarding the Unity game engine bug which causes a slight delay if using both shift keys to control the flippers. We recommend using one shift key on either side and any other keyboard control for the other side's flipper!

* Fixed an issue on Neon Nights 2 regarding flipper control that would occasionally cause a strange bounce off the flippers

* Corrected a couple grammatical errors in the text of two of the loading screens (thank you grammar police :)

* Corrected an issue with a score pop up on left side ramp of Bass Hunter 

* Adjusted the time of the load screens to better match the load in of the table

* Various other texture and bug fixes

notes.title: Update Version 3.8 Leaderboard Patch
notes.content:
Here is a list of the current fixes in todays update:

* Fixed an issue that occasionally caused the game to crash when viewing the leaderboard a second time
* Fixed an issue that occasionally caused the leaderboard to not properly display when viewing after the first game played (the notice screen would be in the way)
* Fixed an issue with the frame rate dropping when retrieving the leaderboard ranking, the frame rate now remains stable
* Added  additional ranks when viewing the leaderboard- Can now view seven players instead of five
* Expanded the size of the backdrop for the leaderboard to properly fit the new ranks
* Fixed an issue on Outergalactic Aliens in which the ball would drain out the right side on a new ball that had been ejected from a ball save
* Adjusted the view rank button to only be active once per session- the leaderboard will remain up and active after playing the next game

notes.title: Slot Shots Pinball Collection Update Version 3.7 (Camera Save Function)
notes.content: We are very pleased to add this small update to the title today, which will now save your preferred camera selection between tables, between games played, even when you close the game and re-open it- this is for all of you who prefer camera three!

notes.title: Slot Shots Pinball Collection Update Version 3.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
* Changed the score pop up fonts found on Slot Shots Casino to match those found in Dream World. 
* Added two additional score shots for Slot Shots Casino.
* Fixed the inlane railings found on both Slot Shots Casino and Outergalactic Aliens (This is the "fencing" found next to the main flippers on both tables).
* Added ten more load screens to bring the total loading screens to 63.
* Removed "Early Access" found throughout the main menu and notes in the loading screens.
* Updated the main menu background video
* Added a new melody that plays when activating Dream World's Multiball 
* Added a new melody that plays when activating the left side drain on Retro Vixel Land. 
* Changed the Multiball activation on Retro Vixel Land so that it does not reset progress on ball loss if you successfully entered the Multiball pipe once.
* Added a structure/foundation for the "start" button found on the outside of pinball machine and updated the "start" button itself (it's no longer just a sticker decal).
* Reduced loading screen time to boot each table by two seconds.
* Fixed issue with the soundtrack for Outergalactic Aliens not correctly adjusting to the music slider setting. 
* Lowered the volume of the spinner found in Bass Hunter by half. 
* Added additional fun facts and notes found in the loading screens.

notes.title: The Dream World Pinball Table Is Live! Slot Shots Pinball Collection Update 3.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42022509/897359180b612c7a13d7dd310fa0e6e39db86456.jpg[/img]

Please don't eat the decorations! Our seventh and final table for the Slot Shots Pinball Collection is here, get ready to enter Dream World! This bright and colorful table features ten main missions, four bonus mini quest shots, an opening skillshot, and of course multiball. Dream World also has a very original "oldies" style soundtrack to go along with plenty ofs dreamy sound effects.

notes.title: Update v3.3 Release The Kraken!
notes.content:
The sixth table that has been added to the collection is now live! Welcome to The Kraken's Cove! Update version 3.3 saw some big changes to our title. 

* Main menu now features a cleaner table selection area, no more scrolling to the right! 
* The Kraken's Cove has been added to the lineup. Get ready for a dark blue and red pirate themed table featuring a moving Kraken that pops up on the table during a mission. This table also features a seventeen minute soundtrack which pushes the entire game's soundtrack to over three hours!
* Minor table adjustments were made to Bass Hunter and Neon Nights 2.
* Corrected an error on achievement unlock for the Slot Shots Casino table. 
* Corrected a score adjustment on a bumper on the Super Vixel Land table to match the score pop up amount. 
* Added an upcoming table slot to the main menu table selection- we are bringing one more table to the collection!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42022509/b9cc545005e73421ed738e52029e30846cb8fef0.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=S9vI0rTci_Y;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
